dataset.name: Classify Leaves
dataset.label_mapping: order of first appearance in train.csv

#0.name: original_baseline
#0.backbone: timm inception_resnet_v2 pretrained ImageNet; num_classes=0; GAP feature 1536-D
#0.head: 1536 -> Linear(1024) -> BN -> SiLU -> Dropout(0.2) -> Linear(1024) -> BN -> SiLU -> Dropout(0.2) -> Linear(176)
#0.feature_extraction_location: second 1024-D block output after Dropout and immediately before final Linear

#1.name: matched_deep_narrow_lambda_1
#1.head: 1536 -> input projection 256 -> five [Linear(256), BN, SiLU, Dropout(0.3)] mapping blocks with fixed residual lambda=1.0 -> stack five stage outputs -> arithmetic mean aggregation -> Dropout(0.2) -> Linear(176)
#1.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of all five post-shortcut stage tensors
#1.feature_extraction_location: 256-D mean aggregation after Dropout and immediately before classifier

#2.name: scaling_only_lambda_0_1
#2.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of all five post-shortcut stage tensors
#2.feature_extraction_location: 256-D mean aggregation after Dropout and immediately before classifier

round2a_mhsa.name: deep_narrow_progressive_mapping_with_mhsa
round2a_mhsa.aggregation: unweighted mean pooling of five fused stages
round2a_mhsa.feature_extraction_location: 256-D fused mean pooling after Dropout and before classifier

common_training_protocol.loss_class_weight: inverse class frequency from the fold training partition, clipped [0.2,5.0], mean-normalized; minority-below-median multiplier 1.1
common_training_protocol.amp_overflow_behavior: skip optimizer update for that batch, record count, and let GradScaler reduce scale
common_training_protocol.checkpoint_selection: maximum deterministic original-view held-out validation accuracy; exact tie selects earlier epoch; stage2 final checkpoint only from stage2
common_training_protocol.evaluation_rule: eval mode, deterministic Resize(299,299)+ImageNet normalization, original view, FP32 logits
common_training_protocol.stage1_batch_augmentation: CutMix p=0.5 alpha=1.0; Mixup p=0.4 alpha=0.4; none p=0.1; alpha linearly decays after 70% epochs
common_training_protocol.bn_adaptation: 50 no-grad training-mode batches from stage2 train loader before stage2 optimizer creation

reporting.mcnemar: exact two-sided binomial test on correctness discordants
